title: [All lasts Dev's] AAPS entrys are deleted  in NightScout next morning
symptom: Canula-, Reservoir-, Battery- and Sensorchange entries entered in AAPS are uploaded to NightScout and appear correct, but by the next morning they are deleted and old values are shown. This does not happen in AAPS.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. A developer suggests that many items are not stored in NightScout and that changes in database and Nightscout client might be related, but no specific cause is confirmed.
fix: The issue was reportedly fixed by a commit, but no specific fix details are given in the thread.
